mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart (user_id, product_id, quantity, checked) VALUES (#{userId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity), checked = 1
mapper.select: SELECT ct.id, ct.user_id, ct.product_id, ct.quantity, ct.checked, ct.created_at, p.name AS product_name, p.price, p.stock, p.main_image, p.status AS product_status FROM cart ct JOIN product p ON ct.product_id = p.id WHERE ct.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY ct.id DESC
SELECT * FROM cart WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.update: UPDATE cart SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE cart SET checked = #{checked} WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE cart SET checked = #{checked} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cart WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
DELETE FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND checked = 1
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId}
